newest_amendment: 21 Feb 2025 — GN 132 of 2025 (Chain A), which deletes and substitutes the Eighth Schedule (recreation fees) and Fourteenth Schedule (tree classification, royalties and other forestry fees) of the Forest Regulations, 2004. Chain B remains at 31 March 2023 (GN 255 of 2023).
note: Reference aid. Cards are paraphrases with page references. Confirm against the gazette before acting. Coverage: 60 distinct sections of the Forest Act Cap. 323 R.E. 2023 are carded (~56% of the 108 operative sections) -- management plans, village/community forest reserves, permit surrender, export/grading/marking, protected plants/animals, fire restrictions and offences, the fee and royalty basis, counterfeiting, entry/information powers, and exemptions. Page citations and penalties have been cross-checked against the Act text (v0.6 pass). Remaining known gaps: ss.19-24 and 27-31 (concessions, declaration, de-reservation -- govern the 'existing rights' defence for cutting in a reserve, the likely real-world follow-up to a84/a26), ss.34-39 and 42-46 (village gazetting steps, Group formation -- flagged on a32/a47), ss.79-83 (Forest Fund -- a94/a95 reference it without a card), s.92 (obstruction), s.106 (research permits, pairs with a67), and ss.96, 99-103, 109.
verificationPolicy: Every provision carries a verification object. Full legal text is the foundational layer; original wording is preserved; missing or uncertain text is explicitly marked and never reconstructed. Publication, commencement and effective dates are kept distinct and never inferred.
